question: Can a grown sender obtain a usable local reference for the actual next payment under either knot law?
inputs: Reconstruct the frozen K,H,G and the one-founder control, whose finite lawful starts and value weights are specified in the design.
forbidden_inputs: Source role assignment, labels, allocator order, externally selected orientation, sender values or aliases at the later receiver. Distinct supplied controls are separately priced.
primary_observable: Locally identifiable relative values, implementable actions, particular paid role, direct physical payment, complete masked recipient support and equal-odds decoding.
cheapest_meaningful_control: Two coeval private values, fixed unequal or mixed bank, and a physically traced external subset with identifiable outsider.
resource_budget: Fourth and fifth cuts bounded by 1024 and 4096 births. Exact local factors and one three-place founding knot.
first_executable_signal: Physical membership of K coeval bank before complete payment to distinct recipients.
stop_rule: A usable prepayment role reference or a witnessed or proved first missing operation under each law, with paid and masked controls.
decision_or_followup_rule: Consider both ability to reverse an undisclosed value and the evidence of the actual fixed masked receiver. Apply GO/STOP.
